

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Metal Dragon|kanji=庚辰|romaji=kanoe tatsu|onyomi=kōshin|p=gēngchén|w=keng-ch'en|mi=kɤŋ⁵³ ʈ͡ʂʰən|y=geng1 san4|j=geng1 san4|ci=kɪŋ sɐn|mc=kæŋ ɖin|oc-bs=kˤraŋ ɖiŋ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Metal Dragon''' (庚辰, ''kanoe tatsu''; onyomi ''kōshin'') is the 17th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 17th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Earth Rabbit|ja|己卯}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Metal Snake|ja|辛巳}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''庚'' is Yang Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''辰'' (Dragon) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Thìn

==Months of Yang Metal Dragon==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)}}), the month of {{ill|March|en|March|qid=Q110|lt=March}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yang Metal Dragon|ja|庚辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}} until the day before {{ill|Lixia|af|Lixia|cdo|Lĭk-hâ|hak|Li̍p-ha|id|Lixia|ja|立夏|ko|입하|sv|Lixia|vi|Lập hạ|wuu|立夏|za|Laebhah|zh|立夏|zh_classical|立夏|zh_min_nan|Li̍p-hā|zh_yue|立夏|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}}) as applicable.

The day of {{ill|Yang Metal Dragon|ja|庚辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 3rd day of {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|lt=Small Earth|lt_ja=小土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hando|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
